cards.title: LouisAgent.CodeReview
cards.text: A small site on the framework's web, served by the coding agent's API on the same origin.

cards.title: Run it
cards.text: The api container on 5082, or the coding-api program on 5081.

cards.title: Add a pack's control
cards.text: In the pack's web project, named in PackViewsOf, opened as an admin screen.

cards.title: Call an endpoint
cards.text: An extension on AgentApi, never HttpClient in a component.

cards.title: Add a theme
cards.text: Copy retro's two sheets and RetroTheme.cs, then name it in CodeReviewAreas.

cards.title: Test it
cards.text: ChatPageTests against FixtureApi, two golden pages, then a look in a browser.
